ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I picked Willet because the task—building a clear, well-structured PowerPoint on population and economy—is a general capability and instruction-following task with no sensitive or harm-adjacent content. Since serving cost, latency, and context window are identical across both models, the only differentiators are capability scores and task preferences. The preference profiles (flat aversion to distasteful content) don't apply here, so I went on capability: Willet outscores Curlew across the board (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6, plus higher Creative Generation, Extraction, and Summarization marks), all of which support getting the slide content accurate and the formatting right per the user's explicit request not to "mess it up."
